visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with long, silver-grey hair and a grey sweatshirt featuring a brand crest on the chest opens a white panel door. Inside a modern bedroom, a man lies under a thick grey duvet on a bed with a large tufted grey headboard. He winces and holds his forehead with his right hand, appearing to be in pain. (2) The woman stands by the entrance of the home holding a large, bright turquoise hardshell suitcase with vertical ridges. She speaks to a young girl in a white sweatshirt and another woman in a yellow top standing in the doorway. She gestures with her free hand before turning to exit. (3) The man in bed peeks out from under the covers, then quickly throws the blanket off as soon as the door closes. He jumps out of bed with a wide, triumphant smile and runs quickly into the living room, displaying high energy and agility compared to his previous state. (4) The man sits cross-legged on a dark grey floor cushion in front of a white circular coffee table, holding a white PlayStation 5 game controller. He talks directly to the camera with animated hand gestures and facial expressions. Professional studio lights and a tripod are visible in the background corner. (5) A large wooden slatted sliding door glides open to reveal the woman returning. She enters the room, looking around and patting her pockets. She notices the man sitting on the floor. He freezes in place, holding the controller with a look of extreme surprise and guilt on his face.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: A comedic short film depicting a common relatable scenario where a husband fakes a headache to avoid visiting relatives during the Lunar New Year holiday. The video highlights the contrast between his feigned illness and his actual excitement to play video games alone, concluding with the humor of being caught when his wife unexpectedly returns.
